    AppointmentObserver
    Observer pattern: anything that wants to react to appointment lifecycle events (console reminders today; email/SMS notifiers could implement this the same way tomorrow) without AppointmentService needing to know about any specific notification channel.
    AppointmentService

    BillFactory
    Factory pattern: the single place that knows how to construct each concrete Bill subtype and stamp it with a generated id, so callers ask for a BillType instead of knowing which Bill subclass to new up themselves.

    BillingService
    Generates and stores bills, using BillFactory to construct the right Bill subtype and a BillingStrategy to work out what the patient actually owes after any discount/coverage.
    BillingStrategy
    Strategy pattern: how a bill's calculated total gets adjusted before payment (no discount, insurance coverage, ...) without BillingService branching on a payer type internally.
